evaluation.summary: 以"内部资料库"业务需求为试炼场，独立评估 NocoBase3 框架的授权/规则/用户认证/数据安装/客户端路由五类能力。框架在记录范围授权、共享与限制规则组合、停用即撤销会话、迁移与种子、路由级页面授权上提供了完整且可验证的原语，最终业务验收（verify-2）B01–B05 全通过，说明能力足以支撑需求。主要短板集中在：selection.records 仅接受非空字符串 id、allScopes 未从包入口导出、共享规则 list() 无过滤参数等易用性/能力暴露问题，以及实现轮次因上下文溢出被工厂误判为 completed 并据此进入 QA 的流程缺陷。评分只反映框架与指引本身，业务实现质量与 QA 结论仅作为使用证据。

modules.name: 数据权限与记录范围
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/authorization 的 record access/composite 选择语义，与 @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization 的 scope 编译、数据库策略执行（withPolicy / RECORD_OUTSIDE_SCOPE），以及 nocobase-app-plugin-authorization Skill 的声明式接入指引。
modules.limitations: 仅覆盖应用实际用到的 read/update 分支与自定义 recordAccess；未系统验证 create/delete、relation 写入与客户端 useCan 的完整行为。

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization
entrypoints: SKILL.md 实现顺序与声明清单

requirements.need: 按记录范围授权（本人草稿 / 已发布且非保密 / 被临时共享的单条）并在读与写上强制执行。
requirements.responsibility: authorization 提供 selection 与 record access 词表，app-plugin-authorization 将其编译为过滤 AST，并在 Repository 上以 withPolicy 施加范围校验。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineRecordAccess + defineDatabasePermission/defineCompositeResource 声明，运行期 authorization.database.policyFor + repository.withPolicy 绑定每个读写。
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/library/scope.ts 定义 readable/nonConfidential/visible/sharedDocument 四个 record access，registration.ts 注册，service.ts 在 225/263/297/347/367 处 withPolicy。

requirements.need: 对单条草稿做临时共享，且草稿主键为整数自增。
requirements.responsibility: 共享规则或授权选择应能定位到具体记录。
requirements.recommendedUsage: sharing rule 的 selection.records([id]) 选择单条记录。
requirements.actualUsage: records 只接受每个 id 均为非空 string，整数主键触发 TypeError；应用改以自定义 recordAccess（key library.sharedDocument，params.documentId）绕行。

requirements.need: 字段级读写白名单，使只读读者无法修改正文。
requirements.responsibility: composite action 的 grant 声明 read/write 字段集合。
requirements.recommendedUsage: read(...).fields(...) 与 update(...).fields(...) 明确列出字段。
requirements.actualUsage: permission 种子为 reader 仅授予 read 且 update 字段受限，editor 限定可写字段；verify-2 乙 PATCH P 得到 403 LIBRARY_FORBIDDEN。

requirements.need: 把多个记录范围按 AND/OR 折叠成单一 scope（如"可读 且 非保密"）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架应导出范围组合原语供应用与插件复用。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用公开的 anyScope/condition/scopeAst 组合。
requirements.actualUsage: allScopes 在 scope.js/scope.d.ts 存在却未从 app-plugin-authorization/server 导出，应用在 scope.ts 自行重写 and 折叠。

findings.title: selection.records 仅接受非空字符串 id，整数主键集合无法直接按单条记录共享
findings.detail: authorization 的 parseRecordSelection 要求 records 的每个 id 都满足 typeof === 'string' 且非空，否则抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')。因此整数自增主键的集合无法用 selection.records([id]) 表达"共享某一条"，只能用 recordAccess 自定义 resolver 绕行。授权 Skill 的共享示例 selection.records(['quote-7']) 使用的是字符串 id，没有暴露这一约束。
findings.impact: 任何使用整数主键的集合（NocoBase 默认 increments('id') 的常见形态）在实现"临时共享单条记录"时都会撞上该限制，必须额外开发 recordAccess 及其 params，抬高接入成本并增加实现分歧。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 parseRecordSelection 中接受数字 id（与主键类型对齐或在编译期按 collection 主键类型校验），或在选择模型层统一 id 的序列化形态；同时在 Skill 示例旁明确记录当前仅支持非空字符串 id。

diagnosis.trigger: 对整数主键集合调用 selection.records([1]) 构造按记录选择。
diagnosis.expected: records 选择能定位到该整数主键记录，并可用于共享/限制规则。
diagnosis.actual: parseRecordSelection 因 id 非字符串抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')，records 选择不可用。
diagnosis.workaround: 定义自定义 recordAccess（如 library.sharedDocument，params.documentId）返回等值条件，规则改用 selection.recordAccess。
diagnosis.acceptance: 在整数主键集合上以 selection.records([id]) 建共享规则，目标用户可读该记录、撤销后 404，且非目标用户不可见。

findings.title: allScopes 已实现但未从 app-plugin-authorization/server 导出
findings.detail: scope.js/scope.d.ts 提供了 allScopes（AND 折叠，遇 false 即 false），但 app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/index.d.ts 的再导出只包含 anyScope/condition/scopeAst，未包含 allScopes。应用在 scope.ts 中为组合"可读 且 非保密"自行重写了 and 折叠逻辑。
findings.impact: 范围组合这类基础原语被逼到应用侧重写，容易与框架内部语义漂移，也增加了代理实现负担与代码量。
findings.suggestedChange: 从 app-plugin-authorization/server 公开导出 allScopes（并补充类型与文档），或在 Skill/README 中明确其替代用法。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用需要把多个 scope 以 AND 组合为单一授权范围。
diagnosis.expected: 直接导入框架提供的 allScopes 完成组合。
diagnosis.actual: 包入口未导出 allScopes，只能复制其折叠逻辑或手工构造 group('and', ...)。
diagnosis.workaround: 在应用 scope.ts 内自行实现等价的 and 折叠。
diagnosis.acceptance: 从 @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server 导入 allScopes 即可完成组合，且与内部 authorizer 使用同一实现。

findings.title: 共享规则 Skill 示例以字符串 id 演示 records，未提示 id 类型限制
findings.detail: nocobase-app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules 的 SKILL.md 用 selection.records(['quote-7']) 作为"为一次交付显式挑选记录"的示例，但底层 parseRecordSelection 只接受非空字符串 id。示例全程以字符串 id 呈现，读者会认为任意主键都可用。

findings.suggestedChange: 在示例旁明确"records 仅接受非空字符串 id；整数主键请使用 recordAccess（或框架后续支持的写法）"，并补一个整数主键的对照示例。
findings.claimed: 共享规则的 selection 可用 selection.records([id]) 选出单条记录，示例 selection.records(['quote-7']) 即表达该能力。
findings.observed: parseRecordSelection 对 records 的每个 id 要求 typeof id === 'string' 且非空，整数主键（如 documents.id）会抛 TypeError('Invalid record selection')，示例形态不能直接用于默认整数主键集合。

findings.title: DatabaseSharingRuleStore.list() 无过滤/分页参数，应用须全量拉取后自行筛选
findings.detail: sharing-rules store 的 list() 不接收任何过滤条件（也无分页），应用 service.ts 的 listShares 只能先 list() 全量规则，再按 SHARE_KEY_PREFIX 前缀在内存中过滤。随着共享数量增长，这一路径缺乏下推能力。
findings.impact: 共享/撤销等管理操作随记录数线性变差，且需要应用维护 key 约定来做筛选，属于可避免的易用性负担。
findings.suggestedChange: 为 store.list 增加可选过滤参数（按 key/资源/主题）或提供按资源查询的接口，并在 Skill 中记录。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用需要列出与某个资源/前缀相关的共享规则。
diagnosis.expected: store 支持按条件查询，只返回相关规则。
diagnosis.actual: list() 无参数，只能取回全部规则后在前缀过滤。
diagnosis.workaround: list() 全量 + SHARE_KEY_PREFIX 前缀过滤（应用 service.ts 已实现）。
diagnosis.acceptance: store 支持按 key/资源过滤后，列表接口只返回相关规则且结果与全量过滤一致。

findings.title: 记录范围授权与 Repository 策略执行闭环可靠，越界目标稳定映射为 404
findings.detail: DatabaseResourceAuthorizer 对 all/records/recordAccess 三种选择统一解析有效范围并把集合策略绑定到 Repository.withPolicy；越界目标由执行适配器映射为 RECORD_OUTSIDE_SCOPE。应用借此把越界读写统一返回 404/403，verify-2 中撤销共享后立即 404。
findings.impact: 为"按记录范围授权"提供了可组合、可验证的底层保证，是满足资料库权限需求的关键支撑。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该语义稳定，并在公开文档中把 RECORD_OUTSIDE_SCOPE/RECORD_NOT_FOUND 的建议映射写成惯例。

findings.title: 停用用户即撤销会话并拒绝再次登录，账户生命周期处理完备
findings.detail: app-plugin-authentication 的 disable 先写 disabledAt 再 revokeSessions（含 deleteUserSessions 与 realtime.disconnectUser），getSession 与登录路径都检查 disabledAt 并返回 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED；app-plugin-users 的 disable 在事务内做 assertSubjectRemovable 与加锁。
findings.impact: 无需业务侧补丁即满足"停用后在线会话立即失效、重新登录被拒"，B05 一次性通过。
findings.suggestedChange: 维持现有行为，并将"不要另建 active 标志"的指引固化为验证清单项。

findings.title: 实现轮次因上下文溢出被截断却记录为 completed，随后修复以套用姊妹分支补丁收尾
findings.detail: 实现代理触发可恢复性失败：agent-implement.jsonl 末尾出现 compaction_end reason:overflow 且摘要失败，最终消息 stopReason:'length'，仅写出 2 个文件；但 result.json 记录 status:'completed'、exitCode:0、incomplete:false，于是 verify-1 对一个空应用验收并失败。之后的修复轮次在搜索姊妹分支后把 origin/agent/issue-554 的补丁 git apply 到工作区并删除了实现代理写出的两个文件，最终交付实际来自该姊妹分支；修复运行记录为 status:'stalled'、exitCode:143、terminalEvent:false。
findings.impact: 交付物的真实来源与运行记录不一致，实现轮次的"完成"状态不可信，评审若只读 result.json 会得出错误结论；也说明流水线缺少对上下文溢出/截断的完成度校验。
findings.suggestedChange: 在流水线中把 compaction overflow/stopReason length 视为未完成并阻止进入 QA；对 result.status 增加"产出文件数/关键路径"校验；修复轮次应记录明确的来源分支与套用补丁动作，并使 terminalEvent/exitCode 与最终状态一致。

diagnosis.trigger: 实现代理的长任务耗尽上下文，触发 overflow 压缩且摘要失败。
diagnosis.expected: 运行被判定为失败/不完整，不进入验收；或提供可续跑路径。
diagnosis.actual: 过程未落盘完整实现，结果却记为 completed/exitCode 0，直接进入 verify-1 并失败。
diagnosis.workaround: 后续修复轮次套用姊妹分支 origin/agent/issue-554 的补丁并删除本地产出，使交付通过 verify-2。
diagnosis.acceptance: overflow/截断运行被明确标记为不完整并阻断 QA；修复轮次能复现其来源分支与补丁动作，且最终状态字段与真实产出、退出码一致。

findings.title: 授权 Skill 缺少紧凑的公开 API 速查，代理易陷入 dist 源码探查
findings.detail: 授权链路细节（selection 形态、policyFor/withPolicy、recordAccess 注册、composite action 与 field/relation 能力）分散在 SKILL.md 与多份 references 中，缺少一页式"任务→公开入口"索引。实现轨迹显示代理为确认声明形状反复 cat node_modules 下的 dist 文件，并伴随一次上下文溢出。
findings.impact: 拉长代理到达可用 API 的路径、增加上下文消耗与出错概率，间接影响实现完整度与耗时。
findings.suggestedChange: 在授权 Skill 增加一页 API 速查表（公开入口、参数、返回值、最小示例），并优先给出应用侧文件的接入骨架，减少对 dist 源码的探查。

## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.

Opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add(...)`; pages need no server registration because the client route tree lists them. Define composite resources with `defineCompositeResource(name, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core` and reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission(configure)` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server`. Both callbacks execute synchronously and return immutable builders; neither registers anything, queries a database or assigns permissions. Register a built resource with `authz.compositeResources.define(resource)`, which returns its `CompositeResourceReference`, and list it in the workspace with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section })`; `resource.reference()` returns the same reference without registering. Use the complete [quote resource declaration](runtime-api.md#declare-a-business-operation) as the starting point and the [permission-set declaration](code-and-seeds.md#share-declarations-not-runtime-instances) to select its data scopes. This reference adds builder semantics and relation capabilities. A composite can also be written as a plain object, `{ name, title, actions: [{ name, title, dataScopes, grants }] }`, where each data scope is `{ key, title, options?, defaultValue? }` and targets the one resource its grants name; the package README shows both forms. The row type passed to `.collection(name)` supplies compile-time field checks, not another runtime schema. DB metadata remains authoritative. Collection registration defines which operations participate in authorization; the permission builder describes requested capabilities independently. The registered Collection action catalogue is enforced when authorizing requests. `grant(key, permission, { title? })` binds a reusable permission to one data scope of the action. The key is stored as `scopeKey` and names the data scope a grant or rule fills with a record selection. The title defaults to the permission's explicit title, or the collection name; override it when one action uses the same collection twice. Different keys allow independent multi-collection configuration. Repeated keys and operations are rejected. A business action composes only `database.collection` grants. `read` describes output fields, while `create` and `update` describe input fields. `delete()` takes no fields. Use `'*'` or `.allFields()` explicitly for all fields. `.options(...recordAccessReferences)` limits the record access a grant may choose and keeps the option names typed on the resource reference; `.default(reference)` sets the value used when a grant chooses nothing. The references must apply to the selected collection. Omitting options offers every registered record access that applies. Define record access with `defineRecordAccess(key, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`, then register it with `authz.recordAccess.define(access)`. Use `.collections(...names)` for applicability (`'*'` for every collection), `.params

(schema)` for typed parameters and `.resolver(fn)` for evaluation. The resolver receives `{ principal, collection, action, params }` and no database objects; it returns `true`, `false`, a filter built with `condition(...)` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server`, or a `FilterAst` built with `buildFilter` from `@nocobase/repository-input`, which the database adapter validates and compiles. Grants and rules never store resolver functions: `.options(...)`, `.default(...)`, relation `.recordAccess(...)` and `selection.recordAccess(key, params?)` store keys. Use stable keys because grants and rules persist them.

# Develop restriction rules

A restriction rule intersects the records an action reaches with the rule's selection, for the subjects it lists. The selection describes the records still allowed, not the records to hide. Several matching restrictions all apply; none can grant an action or widen a range.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-restriction-rules/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For a restriction assigned to a department, or to the root department for the whole company, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. Its core works with permission sets alone and says how to keep excluded records out without this plugin; its optional restriction section covers this one.

## Development workflow

1. State the invariant positively, for example "this team may access only non-confidential projects". Define who it applies to and whether it covers one operation or every path to a collection.
2. Use a rule on a composite, with `scopeKey`, for an operation-specific limit. For a limit across every business branch, create a rule on the `database.collection` with its CRUD actions; the settings page offers declared business data scopes, and collection-wide invariants can be provisioned through the service.
3. Register a suitable record access and save the complete rule. Apply the restriction directly to a user as well when it must remain after that person's team membership is removed.
4. Bind policies on all protected reads and writes. For relation targets, declare relation record access explicitly; a standalone collection restriction is not inherited by nested relation writes.
5. Verify the excluded row stays inaccessible after adding broad sharing and another permission set, across each protected operation, and that unrelated actors keep their intended access.

For example, a confidentiality restriction assigned directly to each account holds whichever permission set grants the action. Test with ordinary users: unrestricted identities skip every rule.

```ts
import { databaseManagerToken } from '@nocobase/db';

const database = app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
```

- **The parent page must place `<Outlet />` itself**, where the child content should appear. Pages do not insert an Outlet automatically, and neither do `RouteChildPage`, `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`; only a plain navigation group gets its Outlet from the route renderer.

A child page that omits `authz` inherits its nearest ancestor page's value; write `'skip'` when the parent page's check is enough and the child needs none of its own, or its own request. A child page renders only after the parent page's check passes.
